intro: One kuih koci has an estimated 130 kcal. Most of the calories come from the glutinous rice flour and the coconut filling with gula melaka.
diet: Yes. One kuih koci isn't high in calories and it's steamed, not fried. But it's mostly carbs and sugar. One piece with an unsweetened drink is enough for a snack.
tips: Pick just one piece as your tea-time snack.
Have it with teh o kosong to avoid double sugar.
Still hungry? Add nuts or a boiled egg, not a second kuih.

swap.name: 1 medium piece boiled ubi (tapioca)
swap.why: Almost the same calories, but no added sugar and more fibre.

faq.q: What leaf is kuih koci wrapped in?
faq.a: Usually banana leaf, folded into a pyramid. The banana leaf gives a nice aroma when steamed.

faq.q: Why does kuih koci stick to the leaf?
faq.a: Brush a little oil on the banana leaf before wrapping so it's easy to open.

faq.q: How long does kuih koci last?
faq.a: Best finished within a day. The coconut filling spoils quickly at room temperature.
